preheader.chosen: Hit reply and it comes straight to me.

paragraphs: Thanks for giving bingd a shot.

The app was inspired by Beli, which changed the way I experienced restaurants. I went from someone who liked eating out occasionally to someone who ranked every restaurant, compared lists with friends, and actively looked for the next place to try.

I built bingd because I think movies and TV are missing that same loop, one that can make the post-watch experience almost as exciting as the watch itself. Rank your latest binge to see where it lands, comment on and save your friends' watches, and find your next title with better recommendations.
If you want to suggest a feature, find something confusing, or just want to say hi, hit reply. It comes straight to me.
